tools.name: schema
tools.title: Database schema
tools.description: Get the schema of the Australian football database: table definitions, column details, query rules, per-competition coverage, join patterns and query API. Valid calls: no params (full schema); competition alone (competition-filtered schema); competition + season + includeObserved:true (measured coverage).

includeObserved.description: Overlay measured coverage for one competition-season. Requires both competition and season.

competition.description: Alone: filter the schema response to this competition. With season + includeObserved:true: the competition to measure.

season.description: Canonical season key or unambiguous year. AFLW 2022 requires 2022-S6 or 2022-S7. Requires competition and includeObserved:true.

tools.name: code
tools.title: Run query code
tools.description: Execute TypeScript code in an isolated sandbox with read-only access to the Australian football D1 database via the `db` variable. The code must return a JSON-serialisable value. Filter every SQL query by competition with JOIN competitions c ... WHERE c.code = ?, as the schema notes show. Sandbox constraints: no network access, no npm imports (standard TypeScript/JavaScript only), 30-second timeout, write/DDL statements rejected, results over 1 MB truncated (narrow with LIMIT or aggregation), rate limited at 60 requests/minute per IP.

code.description: TypeScript code to execute, with `db` (D1Database) in scope.

competition.description: Optional hint naming the competition the query is about. It adds no SQL filter.
